results.title: Bitcoin's future as revolutionary as the smartphone, according to CoinDesk - CNBC
results.content: # Bitcoin's future as revolutionary as the smartphone, according to CoinDesk. We’re still in ‘early innings’ of bitcoin-related ETPs, CoinDesk’s LaValle says. CoinDesk's president of indices and data has a message for investors: Don't count out bitcoin. "When I got my first smartphone, which is a great example of a disruptive technology that has been incorporated into my life, I didn't get the smartphone and say, 'This thing is garbage because I can't get a taxi in front of my home whenever I want it.' I was very excited that I didn't have to carry an MP3 player and my cellphone at the same time," David LaValle told CNBC's "ETF Edge" on Monday. "As it pertains to the future of the digital asset, a lot has transpired, and there have been downdrafts over the past eight years," he said. Looking beyond bitcoin: The next frontier for crypto ETFs. We’re still in ‘early innings’ of bitcoin-related ETPs, CoinDesk’s LaValle says.
